name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Beatrix goes with Southgate, or Rope goes with Oldwall — but not both.
Either Eastcheap goes with Rowan or Boots goes with Southgate.
Southgate goes with at least one of Aldric, Rowan, or Candles.
Both Aldric goes with Riverside and Rope does not go with Eastcheap if and only if either Tapestries goes with Aldric or Rope goes with Rowan (but not both).
Between Eastcheap and Riverside, one goes with Aldric and the other with Beatrix.
If Riverside goes with Aldric, then Candles does not go with Cedric.
Rope goes with exactly one of Beatrix, Edmund, or Eastcheap.
Either Aldric goes with Tapestries, or Cedric goes with Rope — but not both.

hints.text: Suppose Cedric went with Tapestries — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Cedric goes with Tapestries.
Cedric goes with Tapestries, so it can't also go with Rope.
Tapestries goes with Cedric, so Aldric can't go with Tapestries.
…but now the clue “Either Aldric goes with Tapestries, or Cedric goes with Rope — but not both” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Cedric does not go with Tapestries.
